title: Punjab Local Government Ninth Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Ninth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LXV OF 2002
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (NINTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 7th October, 2002]
No. Legis.13-59/2000/VI, dated
7-10-2002. The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Local
Government (Ninth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
